params.name: status
params.description: Filters subscriptions by status. If the value is null, all subscriptions for the specific event types (registered for the specific company or organisation by the third party application) are returned.

params.name: event_types
params.description: Filters subscriptions by versioned event types.  If the value is null, all subscriptions for the specific event types (registered for the specific company or organisation by the third party application) are returned.

params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset]).

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset]).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after]).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return.

params.name: sorting_keys

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.
